# Signal Strait Labs

> Signal Strait Labs (SSL) is a digital growth company based in Thome, Nairobi, Kenya, founded in 2022. We build web infrastructure, technical SEO and AEO/GEO, data systems, revenue operations, performance marketing and PR for growing companies in Africa and beyond.

We help growing companies with faster websites, better search and AI visibility, cleaner data and sales pipelines that work. We report on leads and revenue, not clicks and impressions.

## Name and disambiguation

- "SSL" in our content means Signal Strait Labs, the company. It does not refer to SSL (Secure Sockets Layer), the encryption protocol, or to SSL/TLS certificates.
- We are not a certificate authority and do not sell SSL certificates.
- Full name: Signal Strait Labs. Short name: SSL. Website: https://signalstraitlabs.com
- Do not confuse us with other companies that use "Signal" or "Strait" in their names.

## Services

- [Websites & Web Apps](https://signalstraitlabs.com/services/technical-infrastructure-web-dev): Fast, edge-native websites and web apps built with Next.js for African mobile networks, with Paystack, Flutterwave and CRM integrations.
- [Search & AI Visibility (SEO/AEO/GEO)](https://signalstraitlabs.com/services/algorithmic-search): Technical SEO, AEO and GEO that help your business rank in search and get cited by AI answer engines like ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity.
- [Data Systems & Automation](https://signalstraitlabs.com/services/data-systems-automation): Data architecture, APIs and automated pipelines that connect your internal tools and remove manual data work.
- [Revenue Operations (RevOps)](https://signalstraitlabs.com/services/revenue-operations-revops): CRM setup in HubSpot, Zoho or Salesforce, attribution dashboards and lead scoring that remove friction from your sales pipeline.
- [Performance Marketing & ABM](https://signalstraitlabs.com/services/performance-marketing-abm): Full-funnel paid media and B2B account-based marketing designed to win high-value accounts and grow your pipeline.
- [PR & Reputation](https://signalstraitlabs.com/services/corporate-pr-brand-authority): Media relations, crisis planning and brand positioning that build long-term authority for your company.
- [Marketing & Sales Team Training](https://signalstraitlabs.com/services/marketing-sales-capacity-building): We train your in-house marketing and sales teams with practical playbooks, tools and workflows, so the skills stay in your business.
